name: What is the difference between a full bathroom remodel and a cosmetic update?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a full bathroom remodel and a cosmetic update?

acceptedAnswer.text: A full bathroom remodel typically involves gutting the room down to the studs and subfloor to replace all plumbing fixtures, tile, cabinetry, and finishes. In contrast, a partial remodel only replaces select items such as an existing vanity, mirror, or shower surround while keeping the overall layout intact. Choosing a full remodel lets you relocate plumbing lines, reconfigure layouts for double vanities, update hidden electrical wiring, and correct subfloor moisture damage or framing issues that surface-level updates miss. If your goal is resolving floor plan layout issues or water damage beneath tiles, a full overhaul is the proper approach.
acceptedAnswer.description: A full bathroom remodel guts the space to update plumbing, electrical, and layout, while a cosmetic update only replaces visible fixtures like vanities or tile.
